The iconic water fragrance, deepened and made refillable.

Issey Miyake L'Eau d'Issey Eau de Parfum Intense 100ml is a floral aquatic fragrance for women, launched in 2025 and created by perfumer Amandine Clerc-Marie. A marine posidonia accord opens it with a fresh, watery glow, a heart of sunny ylang-ylang brings rich floral warmth, and it settles into a soft, enveloping vanilla. The bottle unscrews so it can be refilled from the dedicated refill.

  • Wear: Women

  • A fresh posidonia (sea grass) accord opening
  • A warm, sunny ylang-ylang heart
  • A soft, enveloping vanilla base
  • Refillable 100ml Eau de Parfum Intense

FAQ

What does L'Eau d'Issey Eau de Parfum Intense smell like?

Posidonia accord first, then ylang-ylang, finishing with vanilla.

Yes, it is a women's fragrance.
